translations.web: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.
translations.bsb: Though an army encamps around me, my heart will not fear; though a war breaks out against me, I will keep my trust.
translations.kjv: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.
translations.asv: Though a host should encamp against me, My heart shall not fear: Though war should rise against me, Even then will I be confident.
